notes.title: Meet Fourspell Survivors - The first-ever online co-op survivors game!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41323336/933a52448905dff0958bfd5b5e891019e50b4ba5.gif[/img]

Meet our new game, Fourspell Survivors!

Join friends online to survive endless hordes of monsters in the first-ever online coop "survivors" game! Evolve your base and ultimate spells, defeat bosses and develop the best character builds and party formations. Cooperation is key to survive in this action roguelike with unique characters.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2158750/Fourspell_Survivors_Online_Coop/


We know that many "survivors" games are being released at the moment, but playing together with your friends is so much more fun!

Fourspell is being developed with much care and attention to every detail, and many new mechanics and dynamics.


We can't wait to share a playable version with you guys soon. Until then, please wishlist and tell your friends!

notes.title: We just released our new game today with 10% off! Discover Cupid Kiss
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We just launched Cupid Kiss, the newest game in the Cupid universe!
This time we're focusing more on cupid Aelia and her rival Morgan, who wants to disturb the couples' kissing.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1954020/Cupid_Kiss/?beta=0

Cupid Kiss is a cute puzzle game where cupid Aelia needs to bring couples together for them to kiss! 💖💖
The people move in small blocks, inspired by those sliding puzzles you played as a kid. But it won't be easy, as her rival Morgan has called her Imp friends and other obstacles to stand in the couples' way!

[previewyoutube=VQEEJNDF-Os;full][/previewyoutube]

The game was made with a lot of love and I hope you'll be able to see it and have fun with it! ✨✨✨

Big hug, Renan

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 - Fixing issue when you drag the mouse in grid
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Great fixes this time!

Many players have reported that when you drag the mouse through a line, sometimes it skips cells.
This has been fixed in this patch.

Other new cool improvement: if you drag the mouse through a line but then goes back, it'll paint only the cells you last selected.

Ex: lets say you want to paint 4 cells, but move the mouse quickly, painting 5 cells. If you go back a cell, it'll paint only 4. This way you have much more control over which cells you'll paint with each mouse drag.

Hope you guys like it! As always, please let me know if there are any more improvements you want to see.

Best regards,
Renan

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 - Fixing small issues on the build
notes.content:
Fixing small issues on Windows and Mac versions, like:
[list]
[*] the characters cover each other during tutorial (this happens for some players)
[*] leaving a level and continuing it now does not repeat the tutorial
[*] levels currently in progress are now marked on level select screen (with a small pencil icon)
[*] level 45 no longer needs guessing to be solved
[/list]

notes.content: This update improves greatly the stability for Mac users

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 - Release Hotfixes
notes.content:
Fixed many issues related to the following topics:
[list]
[*]game breaking after finishing a stage
[*]game breaking after tutorials
[*]issues on the undo button
[*]screen resolutions and fullscreen toggle options
[/list]

This updated version is much more stable now. Our small team is working hard to fix all the reported bugs.

Sorry for the inconvenience and thanks for the bug reports! It helps us make the game better :)
